rationale: A unanimous, narrow reversal focused on Halberstam’s incorporated limits—especially the missing, nonconclusory nexus between routine platform services and the Reina attack—fits the Chief’s preference for administrable, text-tethered rules. Separate writings are most likely from Justices inclined to emphasize textual limits (Thomas/Gorsuch/Alito) or to flag broader policy/Section 230-adjacent concerns while still agreeing the pleadings fail (Kavanaugh/Jackson).
